title: Pariyerum Perumal BA.BL
desc: A law student develops a friendship with a girl from another caste. However, things take a turn when men from her family confront him over the relationship.

title: Lucky Man
desc: An unlucky real estate agent experiences a bit of luck when he wins a car in a contest. However, things take a turn after the car is stolen by anonymous assailants.

title: Taanakkaran
desc: Arivu and his trainee friends face the wrath of a ruthless trainer, Eshwaramurthy, who later plots schemes to demotivate and punish the entire batch.

title: Naan Sigappu Manithan
desc: After his lover is brutally attacked and left in a coma, Indhiran, who suffers from narcolepsy, becomes a vigilante to take revenge.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Ithu Thaanda Police
desc: Ramakrishna, a police constable, is posted as a driver at Elathur Women's police station. His life becomes challenging as he has to deal with the fiery sub-inspector Arundhati Varma to save his job.
